settings.name: SAML_IGNORE_URI
settings.description: List of PCRE regex patterns (separated by spaces) for URIs excluded from SAML authentication. Patterns are matched against the normalized path, alone or followed by ? and the query string. Takes precedence over SAML_INCLUDE_URI.

settings.name: SAML_INCLUDE_URI
settings.description: List of PCRE regex patterns (separated by spaces) for the only URIs that require SAML authentication; when empty, every URI does. Patterns are matched against the normalized path, alone or followed by ? and the query string. SAML_IGNORE_URI takes precedence. Patterns are unanchored: ^/search also matches /searchengine. Example: SAML_INCLUDE_URI=^/search(/|$) ^/login(/|$).

settings.name: SAML_SP_BASE_URL
settings.description: Public HTTPS origin of this service

settings.name: SAML_IDP_SLO_URL
settings.description: Identity provider HTTPS logout URL (empty uses SSO URL)

settings.name: SAML_USER_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: SAML attribute for user (NameID uses the subject identifier)

settings.name: SAML_EMAIL_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: SAML attribute for email (NameID uses the subject identifier)

settings.name: SAML_GROUPS_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: SAML attribute for groups (NameID uses the subject identifier)

settings.name: SAML_NAME_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: SAML attribute for name (NameID uses the subject identifier)

settings.name: SAML_ACL_RULE_COUNT
settings.description: Number of rules in an explicit ACL list (0 clears the list). Leave empty to discover numbered rules. Managed automatically by the SAML configuration page.

settings.name: SAML_ACL_DENIED_URL
settings.description: Redirect after ACL denial (empty returns the deny status)

settings.name: SAML_ACL_ATTRIBUTE
settings.description: Attribute name to check (NameID uses the subject identifier)

settings.name: SAML_REPLAY_DICT_SIZE
settings.description: Shared-memory capacity for single-instance replay protection

settings.name: SAML_ASSERTION_ENCRYPTION
settings.description: Accept encrypted assertions when optional; require an encrypted assertion when required.

settings.name: SAML_SP_ENCRYPTION_CERT
settings.description: SP decryption certificate in PEM; register this separate encryption key with the IdP.

settings.name: SAML_SP_ENCRYPTION_PRIVATE_KEY
settings.description: Unencrypted RSA private key matching the SP encryption certificate; never displayed.

settings.name: SAML_ALLOW_IDP_INITIATED
settings.description: Allow unsolicited IdP logins without browser request correlation.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_INITIATED_RETURN_PATHS
settings.description: Exact local return paths; first is the default when RelayState is absent.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_METADATA_SOURCE
settings.description: Choose manual IdP fields, imported XML, or periodically refreshed HTTPS metadata.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_METADATA_XML
settings.description: IdP metadata XML contents, at most 64 KiB; select the entity with SAML_IDP_ENTITY_ID.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_METADATA_URL
settings.description: HTTPS metadata URL, without credentials or fragment; redirects are refused.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_METADATA_CA_CERT
settings.description: Optional PEM CA certificates added to system trust for this metadata URL.

settings.name: SAML_IDP_METADATA_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URL
settings.description: Permit private and loopback metadata destinations; TLS verification remains required.
